what: TE Connectivity makes connectors and sensors: the parts that carry power, signal and data between components in cars, factory machines, aircraft, medical devices and data centre equipment.
customers: Carmakers and their suppliers, industrial equipment manufacturers, data centre builders, aerospace and medical device companies.
money: connectors and sensors for cars, trucks and off-highway vehicles
connectors for factory automation, aerospace, energy and data centres
connectors for data centres and appliances
moat: Parts designed into a vehicle or machine platform years ahead, with qualification cycles that keep a supplier in place for the product's life.
risks: Car production volumes have been falling in Europe
Industrial demand in Europe and China has been weak
Content per vehicle depends on electric vehicle adoption rates
Tariffs disrupt a business with plants in many countries
opportunities: Revenue grew about 15% in the last financial year, led by data centre connectors
AI servers need far more high-speed connectors per rack
Electric and software-defined cars carry more connector content than older vehicles
watch: Industrial Solutions growth, especially the data centre portion, and orders.
